id: 31_Test Your Basic Safety Knowledge Work at Height Crane Safety Scaffolding Safety
title: 高处作业：争取一次过关（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/31_Test Your Basic Safety Knowledge Work at Height Crane Safety Scaffolding Safety.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/31_Test Your Basic Safety Knowledge Work at Height Crane Safety Scaffolding Safety（国内版）/src.py

points.K6: 救援计划为了尽快救人
points.S1: 高处储物柜固定防倾倒

shots.scene: 欣欣站在梯子旁，举起一张空白答卷
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a step ladder holding up a blank answer sheet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 高处作业小测验，争取一次过关！
overlay: 高处作业：争取一次过关

shots.scene: 阿杰拿到答卷就开始乱勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student starts ticking boxes on a blank answer sheet at random without reading.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿到卷子，看都不看就勾。

shots.scene: 小研递给他一本空白学习手册
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him a blank study booklet.
shots.narration: 小研说：先看材料，再答题。

shots.scene: 多个主题卡片：射线、化学品、脚手架、电气、高处
shots.prompt_en: A row of topic cards: a radiation trefoil, a chemical bottle, scaffolding, a lightning bolt and a ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 安全考试有很多主题。

shots.scene: 空白测验框：十格进度条和计时器
shots.prompt_en: A blank quiz panel with ten progress segments and a countdown timer. No people.
shots.narration: 每套十题十分钟，八题对才过。

shots.scene: 一大群人只有少数打勾
shots.prompt_en: A crowd of small person icons where only a few have green checks above them. No people.
shots.narration: 第一次就过的人很少。

shots.scene: 阿杰认真翻看手册
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads the study booklet carefully at a desk.
shots.narration: 先把材料读懂，第一次就能过。

shots.scene: 三个图标：坠落的人、断裂的挂钩、风雨云
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a falling person, a broken hook and a wind and rain cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 先了解高处作业的风险。

shots.scene: 老李站在梯子上，窗外刮风
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands on a ladder indoors while strong wind blows outside the window.
shots.narration: 人会坠落，设备会失效，天气会添乱。

shots.scene: 高楼、夜晚月亮、雨伞三张卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three cards crossed out with red X marks: a tall building, a night moon and an umbrella. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么时候要防坠落保护？

shots.scene: 人站在平台边缘，旁边护栏和安全带图标
shots.prompt_en: A person icon near a platform edge, with a guardrail icon and a harness icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 只要有从高处坠落的风险，就要防护。

shots.scene: 王老师翻开国家标准
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank standards book.
shots.narration: 高处作业分级，按国家标准执行。

shots.scene: 价格标签、颜色色卡图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A price tag icon and a color swatch icon, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：选梯子要考虑什么？

shots.scene: 四个图标：高度尺、砝码、材质块、任务卡
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a height ruler, a weight, a material sample block and a task card. No people.
shots.narration: 高度、承重、材质，还有干什么活。

shots.scene: 老李选了一把绝缘梯准备修灯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer picks a non-conductive ladder to work near a light fixture.
shots.narration: 靠近电线干活，选绝缘材质的梯子。

shots.scene: 老李检查安全带的织带和挂钩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the webbing and hook of a full body harness.
shots.narration: 第三题：防坠落装备多久查一次？

shots.scene: 一年、半年、坏了才查的日历图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Calendar icons for yearly and half-yearly checks and a broken icon, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 每次用之前都要查。

shots.scene: 空白说明书和带勾的检查记录
shots.prompt_en: A blank manufacturer manual and a blank inspection record with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 再按说明书要求，定期专项检查。

shots.section_title: 救援计划为了尽快救人
shots.scene: 老李挂在安全带上，悬在半空
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hangs from his harness lanyard below a beam after a fall, holding still.
shots.narration: 第四题：为什么要有救援计划？
overlay: 救援计划为了尽快救人

shots.section_title: 救援计划为了尽快救人
shots.scene: 应付检查、只为合规的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a person showing off and a stamp on a form. No people.
shots.narration: 不是为了应付检查。

shots.section_title: 救援计划为了尽快救人
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员推来移动平台把老李接下
shots.prompt_en: The security officer brings a mobile platform and helps the facility engineer down safely.
shots.narration: 是为了出事时迅速、安全地把人救下。

shots.scene: 阿杰的答卷全是对勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up an answer sheet full of green checks.
shots.narration: 阿杰先学再考，一次过关。

shots.section_title: 高处储物柜固定防倾倒
shots.scene: 实验室高处试剂柜，没有固定，被碰得晃动
shots.prompt_en: A tall reagent cabinet in a laboratory wobbles when bumped, not fixed to the wall. No people.
shots.narration: 高高的试剂柜，一碰就晃。
overlay: 高处储物柜固定防倾倒

shots.section_title: 高处储物柜固定防倾倒
shots.scene: 老李用支架把柜子固定在墙上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fixes the tall cabinet to the wall with metal brackets.
shots.narration: 高柜、试剂架要固定在墙上。

shots.section_title: 高处储物柜固定防倾倒
shots.scene: 重物放下层、轻物放上层
shots.prompt_en: Heavy bottles placed on the lower shelves and light boxes on the upper shelves. No people.
shots.narration: 重的放下层，轻的放上层。

shots.scene: 悬挂的人形和一个计时器
shots.prompt_en: A person icon hanging in a harness beside a stopwatch icon. No people.
shots.narration: 挂在安全带上不能久等。

shots.scene: 腿部血流受阻的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple body outline with leg straps highlighted and red arrows showing restricted circulation. No people.
shots.narration: 腿带勒久了，会影响血液循环。

shots.scene: 老周拨打电话，屏幕上 120
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls on his phone while looking up at the scene.
shots.narration: 按预案尽快解救，必要时拨120。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着松垮的安全带，腿带垂下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears a loose full body harness with leg straps hanging slack.
shots.narration: 安全带松松垮垮，等于没穿。

shots.scene: 小研帮他收紧胸带和腿带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps him tighten the chest strap and leg straps.
shots.narration: 胸带腿带收紧，按说明书调到贴身。

shots.scene: 阿杰抬腿弯腰活动，安全带不勒不松
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends and lifts his knee to test comfort in the adjusted harness.
shots.narration: 活动一下，不勒不松，干活才不累。

shots.scene: 一排图标：手册、护栏、梯子、检查表、救援平台
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a study booklet, a guardrail, a ladder, a checklist and a mobile rescue platform. No people.
shots.narration: 先学再考：有风险就防护，用前必检查。

shots.scene: 固定好的柜子和调好的安全带
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet bolted to the wall and a properly adjusted harness on a hook. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子固定好，安全带调合身。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye next to the ladder.
shots.narration: 先学再上手，安全一次过！
